content_zh:
他凝视着棺木中的脸，生得与邢烨有五分像，比起素来冷硬的他多了丝柔和。
相由心生，邢烁正如他的容貌一般，是个性格温和接人待物十分宽容的人。
他是邢烨的弟弟，比邢烨小五岁，今年才二十四，却已经躺在这冰冷的棺木中，而空旷的灵堂里，守夜的也仅有邢烨一人。
自从九年前父母意外身故，邢烁与邢烨相依为命，彼此是对方唯一的家人。
而现在，邢烁也离开了他。
听到邢烁的死讯时，身在国外的邢烨无论如何也不能相信，自己年轻健康的弟弟就这样去世了。
他立刻将手中的工作交给下属处理，回国后便以死者唯一亲属的身份要求调查邢烁的死因。可不论警方还是医院，给出的答案都只有一个——心源性猝死。
邢烁目前在京大准备硕士论文，每天泡在图书馆中，从未与人结怨。而法医全面的解剖报告也排除了药物因素，死因的的确确是急性心肌梗死。
“很多突发性死亡的人平时表现都十分健康，没有任何异状，邢烨先生，我明白你的心情，可是邢烁的死因确实是病故，不存在人为因素。”
警方的回答回荡在邢烨脑海中，他伸出冻僵的手轻轻触碰邢烁的脸，在敛容师的巧手下，邢烁如生前一般浅笑着，好似在做一个极为美丽的梦。
邢烨将脸扭开抬头看向窗外的星星，生怕自己的眼泪落在弟弟的遗体上。
从今以后，他就是一个人了。
繁星从来不知人世悲苦，无论人类多么悲伤，它们依旧璀璨。邢烨看了一会儿觉得眼花缭乱，裹紧价值不菲的大衣坐在灵堂准备的椅子上。
秋风卷起落叶的“沙沙”声让已经三天未合眼的邢烨身体发沉，渐渐进入梦乡。
梦里依稀回到与邢烁最后一次见面，那时邢烨正要准备出国，邢烁拿着手机叫住了他：“哥……”
站在门前的邢烨回头看他。
邢烁的手机屏幕亮着，他像以往一样笑笑：“一路顺风。”
“希望我回来时，你的硕士论文已经通过了。”邢烨一如既往地在弟弟面前维持着威严强大的形象，嘱咐了他的学业后便匆匆离开。
这一去，从此天人两隔。
一阵冷风吹过，邢烨猛地睁开眼，手表显示现在是01:30分。

他很少做梦，即使做了也记不住内容。但方才的梦境仿佛场景重现，梦里邢烁的每一个小动作都历历在目。
梦中，邢烁的左手轻轻挠着裤线，着急出门的邢烨并未注意到，此时在睡梦中重现了。
从小到大，邢烁有事想同他商量却又不敢开口时，都会做出这样的小动作。
当时邢烁并不是想向我道别，而是有事要说，但我急着走，他又很犹豫，就没有提。邢烨暗暗想道，仔细地回忆着每个画面。
他穿着一件深灰色的毛衣，黑色休闲裤，左手挠裤线，右手举着手机，手机屏幕亮着，画面是……
一个黑白相间的二维码！
回想起这个画面的邢烨意识到，那时邢烁是点开手机中的二维码图片，要与他商量什么事情。
他立刻拿起被随意丢在角落里的公文包，取出平日里记载重要工作的笔记本，又从怀中掏出常用的签字笔，一点点描绘着记忆中的二维码。
邢烨有简单的绘画基础，笔记本的页面是细小的正方格，只要按照比例将相应的格子涂黑，就可以还原二维码。
邢烨从小记忆力极好，大学时还专门报过速记班，就算达不到过目不忘的程度也相差无几。
细心地涂好最后一笔，邢烨闭目回想了下，确定自己绘制的二维码与记忆中的一致，便拿出手机点开扫一扫，对准二维码扫描。
“滴”的一声，手机屏幕上出现一个从未见过的黑白页面，界面中有个对话框：玩家邢烁邀请你参加挑战命运的游戏，是否接受？是/否
邢烁在准备硕士论文的关键时期还在玩手游？不太可能，而且他也不会与我商量一个游戏的事情。
所谓“挑战命运的游戏”一定不是简单的游戏，其中另有深意。但不入虎穴焉得虎子，邢烨没有犹豫，直接点击“是”。
在手指碰触到屏幕的瞬间，邢烨惊讶地发现自己的手臂变成黑白色，且不再是立体的、具有空间感的，而是成为一个平面的图案。

content_en:
He stared at the face in the coffin, which looked exactly like Xing Ye, and was a little softer than his usual coldness.
The appearance comes from the heart. Just like his appearance, Xing Shuo is a gentle and tolerant person.
He is Xing Ye's younger brother, five years younger than Xing Ye. He is only twenty-four this year, but he is already lying in this cold coffin. In the empty mourning hall, only Xing Ye is keeping vigil.
Since their parents died unexpectedly nine years ago, Xing Shuo and Xing Ye have been dependent on each other, each being the other's only family.
And now, Xing Shuo has also left him.
When he heard the news of Xing Shuo's death, Xing Ye, who was abroad, could not believe that his young and healthy brother had died like this.
He immediately handed over the work in hand to his subordinates, and after returning home, he requested an investigation into the cause of Xing Shuo's death as the only relative of the deceased. But both the police and the hospital gave only one answer - sudden cardiac death.
Xing Shuo is currently preparing his master's thesis at Beijing University. He spends time in the library every day and has never had any grudges with anyone. The forensic medical examiner's comprehensive autopsy report also ruled out drug factors, and the cause of death was indeed acute myocardial infarction.
"Many people who die suddenly appear to be very healthy and show no abnormalities. Mr. Xing Ye, I understand how you feel, but Xing Shuo's death was indeed due to illness and there was no human factor."
The police's answer echoed in Xing Ye's mind. He reached out his frozen hand and gently touched Xing Shuo's face. Under the skillful hands of the facial contouring artist, Xing Shuo smiled as if he were alive, as if he was having a very beautiful dream.
Xing Ye turned his face away and looked up at the stars outside the window, fearing that his tears would fall on his brother's body.
From now on, he is alone.
The stars never know the misery of the world. No matter how sad humans are, they still shine brightly. Xing Ye looked at it for a while and felt dazzled. He wrapped his valuable coat tightly and sat on the chair prepared in the mourning hall.
The rustle of fallen leaves in the autumn wind made Xing Ye, who had not slept for three days, feel heavy and gradually fell asleep.
In the dream, he vaguely returned to the last meeting with Xing Shuo. At that time, Xing Ye was about to go abroad. Xing Shuo stopped him with his cell phone: "Brother..."
Xing Ye, who was standing in front of the door, looked back at him.
Xing Shuo's phone screen lit up, and he smiled as usual: "Have a nice trip."
"I hope your master's thesis has been passed when I come back." Xing Ye, as always, maintained a majestic and powerful image in front of his younger brother, and left in a hurry after giving instructions on his studies.
This time, heaven and man are separated from each other.
A gust of cold wind blew by, and Xing Ye opened his eyes suddenly. His watch showed that it was 01:30.
He rarely dreams, and even when he does he cannot remember the content. But the dream just now seemed to reappear, and every little move by Xing Shuo in the dream was vividly remembered.
In the dream, Xing Shuo's left hand was gently scratching the line of his pants. Xing Ye, who was in a hurry to go out, did not notice it, but it reappeared in his sleep.
Ever since he was young, Xing Shuo would do this little thing when he wanted to discuss something with him but didn't dare to speak.
At that time, Xing Shuo didn't want to say goodbye to me, but he had something to say, but I was in a hurry to leave and he was hesitant, so he didn't mention it. Xing Ye thought secretly, recalling every scene carefully.
He was wearing a dark gray sweater and black casual pants. He scratched the trouser line with his left hand and held up his mobile phone with his right hand. The screen of the mobile phone was on, and the picture was...
A black and white QR code!
Recalling this scene, Xing Ye realized that Xing Shuo had clicked on the QR code picture on his phone to discuss something with him.
He immediately picked up the briefcase that was thrown casually in the corner, took out the notebook where he usually recorded important work, and took out the commonly used pen from his arms, and traced the QR code in his memory bit by bit.
Xing Ye has a simple foundation in painting. The pages of his notebook are small square grids. As long as the corresponding grids are blackened according to the proportion, the QR code can be restored.
Xing Ye has had an excellent memory since he was a child., I even took a shorthand class when I was in college, and even if I didn’t reach the level of photographic memory, it was almost the same.
After carefully applying the last stroke, Xing Ye closed his eyes and thought about it for a moment, making sure that the QR code he drew was consistent with the one in his memory, then he took out his mobile phone and scanned it, aiming at the QR code to scan.
With a "beep" sound, a black and white page that had never been seen before appeared on the screen of the mobile phone. There was a dialog box in the interface: Player Xing Shuo invites you to participate in a game that challenges destiny. Do you accept it? yes/no
Is Xing Shuo still playing mobile games during the critical period of preparing his master's thesis? It's unlikely, and he won't discuss a game with me.
The so-called "game that challenges destiny" is definitely not a simple game, it has a deeper meaning. But there is no way to get the tiger's cubs without entering the tiger's den. Xing Ye did not hesitate and clicked "Yes" directly.
The moment his finger touched the screen, Xing Ye was surprised to find that his arm turned black and white, and was no longer three-dimensional and spatial, but became a flat pattern.
